jd:
Data Scientist - Quillon Labs

About the role
Quillon Labs forecasts energy demand for utilities and is hiring a data scientist for its modelling team. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build and evaluate forecasting models
- Deploy models with engineers
- Communicate results to utility partners

Requirements
- Python with scikit-learn
- SQL
- Statistics
- Deploying models to production
- Deep learning with PyTorch

Nice to have
- Spark

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
